LESSON: KNITTING SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Knitting Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Knitting Skills, part of Production Techniques in Grade 7 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How do you knit an article for household use?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe knitting stitches used in making household articles

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Knitting Skills in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. knit various articles for household use

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Knitting Skills in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

T. . • knit a simple household article such as a tool bag, scarf, gloves, mats, or table wipers. • display knitted work to embrace the use of knitted articles for household use. How do you knit an article for household use?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Knitting Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Integrity: prudent use of materials and equipment in the knitting of household articles.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety of self and others as learners use sharp knitting tools.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learners relate knitting to weaving techniques learnt in Creative Arts and Sports.
